summary_zh: 前文称张凌赫饰演的谢征在《Pursuit of Jade》中位列Top1，并引用小红书观看量、讨论量等数据强调其压倒性热度。收录帖未转向商品、价格或配送体验，而是聚焦角色影响力；后续继续补充其为播出期人气驱动因素。该上下文显示舆情偏正面传播，真实性主要依赖所列平台数据来源。

posts.text: Top1 #XieZheng by #ZhangLinghe #PursuitofJade, completely dominates all other positions in terms of viewership growth rate 7.1 B & total views 12.8 B on Xiaohongshu. The incremental discussion volume 1.69 M & total discussion volume 3.292 M far exceed almost all other characters.
posts.original_text: Top1 #XieZheng by #ZhangLinghe #PursuitofJade, completely dominates all other positions in terms of viewership growth rate 7.1 B & total views 12.8 B on Xiaohongshu. The incremental discussion volume 1.69 M & total discussion volume 3.292 M far exceed almost all other characters.
posts.translation_zh: Top1 由 #ZhangLinghe 饰演的 #PursuitofJade 中的 #XieZheng，在 Xiaohongshu 上以 7.1 B 的观看量增长率和 12.8 B 的总观看量，完全碾压其他所有位置。1.69 M 的讨论增量和 3.292 M 的总讨论量远超几乎所有其他角色。

posts.text: Zhang Linghe's character Xie Zheng serves as the primary popularity driver, generating an exceptionally strong media impact on the Xiaohongshu platform during its broadcast period (from March 6, 2026 to April 29, 2026).
